text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The one-piece dress I had reserved at Camellia arrived.
I thought I'd check out their new arrivals while I was at it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, you shop at Camellia?
Nice, I have some earrings from there myself."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What? ...Even I wear
high-end brands sometimes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, that's not what I meant...! I thought you would say, 'As expected of a young lady.'

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd tell you. Kinda surprising though,
I didn't think you'd care about stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I don't mind at all.
However, most people say that with no ill intent."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...You see them every now and then, though. The kind of girl decked out head-to-toe in luxury brands, where you notice the clothes before you even notice her."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wouldn't really call you an 'ojousama.'
I mean, you're always standing tall with your back straight."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm just wearing clothes that let me love myself the most, hold my head high, and get super hyped. That's all there is to it, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fashion is a value I choose for myself...
Wearing top-class designs is
proof that a King is a King!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, words of wisdom right there.
Well, hope you make a great encounter.
